G2900.def:
κραταιός, -ά, -όν
(κράτος), (in cl. poët, form of κρατερός), [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק and cognates ;]
strong, mighty: 1Pe 5:6.†
(AS)

G2901.def:
κραταιόω, -ῶ
(late form of κρατύνω; κράτος) [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;]
to strengthen; pass., to wax strong: Lc 2:40, 1Co 16:13; πνεύματι, Lc 1:80; δυνάμει κ. διὰ τ. πνεύματος, Ef 3:16.†
(AS)

G2902.def:
κρατέω, -ῶ
(κράτος), [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק hi., also for אָחַז, etc. ;]
__1. to be strong, mighty, hence, to rule, be master, prevail (so chiefly in cl.; in LXX: Et 1:1, I Et 4:38, Wis.14:19, al.).
__2. to get possession of, obtain, take hold of (Hdt., Thuc., al.): with genitive of thing(s) (M, Pr., 65), At 27:13; τ. χειρός, Mt 9:25, Mc 1:31 5:41 9:27, Lc 8:54; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 12:11; with accusative of person(s), Mt 14:3 18:28 21:46 22:6 26:4, 48 ff., Mc 3:21 6:17 12:12 14:1, 44 ff, At 3:11 24:6, Ap 20:2 (cf. 2Rs 6:6).
__3. to hold, hold fast (Æsch., Polyb., al.): with accusative of thing(s), ἐν τ. δεξιᾷ, Ap 2:1. Metaphorical: with accusative of person(s), pass., At 2:24; with accusative of thing(s), Ap 2:13, 25 3:11; τ. κεφαλήν (i.e. Christ), Cl 2:19; τ. παράδοσιν (-εις), λόγον, διδαχήν, Mc 7:3-4, 8 9:10, 2Ts 2:15, Ap 2:14-15; with genitive of thing(s), Hb 4:14 6:18; of sins, to retain, Jo 20:23; of re­straint, before ἵνα μή, Ap 7:1; pass., before τοῦ μή, Lc 24:16.†
(AS)

G2903.def:
κράτιστος, -η, -ον
superl, of κρατύς (Hom.),
__1. strongest, mightiest (Hom.).
__2. noblest, best (cf. κρείσσων), most excellent (find., Soph., al.): voc., κρατίστε, as title of honour and respect (DCG, ii, 727a), Lc 1:3, At 23:26 24:3 26:25.†
(AS)

G2904.def:
κράτος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX chiefly for עֹז, Jó 12:16, Sl 90:11 al. ;]
__1. strength, esp. as in Hom., of bodily strength.
__2. power, might: Hb 2:14; τὸ κ. τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ, Ef 1:19 6:10 (Is 40:26, Da TH Dn 4:27); τ. δόςης αὐτοῦ, Cl 1:11; κατὰ κράτος, mightily, At 19:20; a mighty deed, an act of power, Lc 1:51; in doxologies, 1Tm 6:16, 1Pe 4:11 5:11, Ju 25, Ap 1:6 5:13.†
(AS)

G2905.def:
κραυγάζω (κραυγή)
[in LXX: Et 3:13 (רוּעַ hi.)* ;] = κράζω
__1. of animals, to bay, to croak, etc.
__2. Of men, to cry out, shout: Mt 12:19, Jo 12:13 19:15 At 22:23; before λέγων, Jo 18:40 19:6, 12; καὶ λέγων, Lc 4:41 (WH, κράζ -); φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, Jo 11:43 (cf. Abbott, JV, 269 f.).†
(AS)

G2906.def:
κραυγή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for צְוָחָה, תְּרוּעָה, שַׁוְעָה, etc. ;]
crying, outcry, clamour: Mt 25:6, Lc 1:42, At 23:9, Ef 4:31, Hb 5:7, Ap 21:4.†
(AS)

G2907.def:
κρέας, -έως, pl., κρέα
[in LXX for בָּשָׂר (freq.) ;]
flesh, meat: Rm 14:21, 1Co 8:13.†
(AS)

G2908.def:
κρείσσων
(Epic and old Att..) and κρείττων (later Att..), prop. comparat. of κρατύς, strong, but in sense often (as in cl., see LS, see word) as comparat. of ἀγαθός, [in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;]
better;
__(a) as to ad­vantage or usefulness: 1Co 11:17, Hb 11:40 12:24; πολλῷ μᾶλλον κ., Fp 1:23; κρεῖσσον ποιεῖν, 1Co 7:38; ἐστιν, before inf., 1Co 7:9, 2Pe 2:21;
__(b) as to excellence: Hb 1:4 6:9 7:7, 19 7:22 8:6 9:23 10:34 11:16, 35; κ. ἐστι, before inf., 1Pe 3:17.†
(AS)

G2910.def:
κρεμάννυμι
(also κρεμαννύω, κρεμάω; the Pres. is not found in NT), [in LXX (where also κρεμάζω, Jó 26:7) chiefly for תָּלָה ;]
trans., to hang, suspend: with accusative of person(s), before ἐπὶ ξύλου, At 5:30 10:39; pass., Lc 23:39; before περί, Mt 18:6. Mid., κρέμαμαι, intrans., to hang: before ἐκ, At 28:4; ἐπὶ ξύλου, Gl 3:13 (LXX); metaphorically, before ἐν, Mt 22:40.†
(AS)

G2911.def:
κρημνός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κρεμάννυμι), [in LXX: 2Cr 25:12 (סֶלַע)* ;]
a steep bank: Mt 8:32, Mc 5:13, Lc 8:33.†
(AS)

G2912.def:
Κρής, ὁ, pl., Κρῆτες
a Cretan: At 2:11, Tt 1:12.†
(AS)

G2915.def:
κριθή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for שְׂעֹרָה ;]
barley: pl. (as usually in cl.), Ap 6:6.†
(AS)

G2917.def:
κρίμα (B1., § 27, 2), -τος, τό
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט ;]
the issue of a judicial process, hence,
__1. judgment, the decision passed on the faults of others: Mt 7:2; in forensic sense, with genitive pun., Lc 24:20; esp. of the judgment of God, Rm 2:2 5:16 11:33 (ICC, in l), 2Pe 2:3, Ju 4; κ. λαμβάνεσθαι, Mt 23:13 (Rec., R, mg.), Mc 12:40, Lc 20:47, Rm 13:2, Tg 3:1; ἔχειν, 1Tm 5:12; βαστάζειν, Gl 5:10; ἐσθίειν ἑαυτῷ, 1Co 11:29; εἰς κ. συνέρχεσθαι, 1Co 11:34; εἶναι ἐν τ αὐτῷ κ., Lc 23:40; with genitive obj., Rm 3:8, 1Tm 3:6, Ap 17:1; of God's judgment through Christ, Jo 9:39; τὸ κ. ἄρχεται, 1Pe 4:17; τ. κ. τ. μέλλον, At 24:25; κ. αἰώνιον, Hb 6:2; ἔκρινεν ὁ Θεὸς τ. κ. ὐμῶν, Ap 18:20; of the right of judgment, Ap 20:4.
__2. a matter for judgment, a law-suit, a case: 1Co 6:7.†
(AS)

G2918.def:
κρίνον, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּשַׁן ;]
a lily: Mt 6:28, Lc 12:27.†
(AS)

G2919.def:
κρίνω,
[in LXX chiefly for שׁפט, also for ריב ,דּין, etc. ;]
__1. to separate, select, choose (cl.; in LXX: 2Ma.13:15).
__2. to approve, esteem: Rm 14:5.
__3. to be of opinion, judge, think: Lc 7:43, 1Co 11:13; before τοῦτο ὅτι, 2Co 5:14; with accusative and inf., At 16:15; with accusative and pred., At 13:46 26:8.
__4. to decide, determine, decree: with accusative, At 16:4, Rm 14:13, 1Co 7:37, 2Co 2:1; with inf. (Field, Notes, 167), At 20:16 25:25, 1Co 2:2 5:3, Tt 3:12 (cf. 1Ma.11:33, Wis.8:9, al.); with accusative and inf., At 21:25 27:1.
__5. to judge, adjudge, pronounce judgment: absol., Jo 8:16, 26; before κατά, with accusative, Jo 7:24 8:15; κρίσιν κ., Jo 7:24; τ. δίκαιον, Lc 12:57 (Deiss., LAE, 118); in forensic sense, Jo 18:31, At 23:3, al.; pass., Rm 3:4 (LXX); of God's judgment, Jo 5:30 8:50, Rm 2:16 3:6, 2Tm 4:1, 1Pe 4:5, al.
__6. = κατακρίνω, to condemn (cl.): At 13:27; of God's judgment, Jo 3:18 5:22 12:47, 48, At 7:7, Rm 2:12, 1Co 11:32, Hb 10:30" (LXX), Tg 5:9, Ap 19:2, al.
__7. As in LXX (for שׁפט), to rule, govern ( 4Ki.15:5, Sl 2:10, al.): Mt 19:28, Lc 22:30, 1Co 6:3.
__8. to bring to trial (cl.); mid., to go to law: with dative of person(s), Mt 5:40; before μετά, with genitive of person(s) (of the opponent), ἐπί, with genitive (of the judge), 1Co 6:1, 6 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἀντ-απο- (-μαι), δια-, ἐν-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συν-, ὑπο- (-μαι), συν-υπο- (-μαι)).
SYN.: see: δικάστης. (AS)

G2920.def:
κρίσις, -εως, ἡ
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט, also for רִיב, etc. ;]
__1. a seperating, selection (Arist., al.)
__2. a decision, judgment (cl.): Jo 8:16, 1Tm 5:24, 2Pe 2:11, Ju 9; κ. κρίνειν, Jo 7:24; in forensic sense, At 8:33 (LXX) (see Page, in l); esp. of the Divine judgment, Jo 3:19 5:24, 27 5:29-30 12:31 16:8, 11, 2Ts 1:5, Hb 10:27, Tg 2:13 5:12, 2Pe 2:4, Ap 18:10; pl., Ap 16:7 19:2; of the last judgment, Mt 10:15 11:22, 24 12:36, 41-42 Lc 10:14 11:31-32, Hb 9:27, 2Pe 2:9 3:7, 1Jo 4:17, Ju 6 15; τῆς γεέννης, Mt 23:33.
__3. By meton. (as in LXX for מִשְׁפָּט, Is 5:7, al.; דִּישׁוֹן, Dn 7:10), of the standard of judgment, right, justice: Mt 12:18, 20 (LXX, Isa 42:43) Isa 23:23, Lc 11:42; of the tribunal (a local court), Mt 5:21-22†
(AS)

G2922.def:
κριτήριον, -ου, τό
(κριτής), [in LXX: 3Ki.7:7 (מִשְׁפָּט), Dan LXX TH Dn 7:10, 26, (דִּין), Su 1:49, Êx 21:6, Jz 5:10 * ;]
__1. a means of judging, test, criterion.
__2. a tribunal: 1Co 6:2 6:4, Tg 2:6.†
(AS)

G2923.def:
κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁפַט ;]
a judge: Mt 5:25, Lc 12:14, 58 18:2; τ. ἀδικίας, Lc 18:6; with gem of thing(s) (obj.), At 18:15, Tg 4:11; (qual.), διαλογισμῶν πονηρῶν, Tg 2:4; of a Roman procurator, At 24:10; of God, Hb 12:23, Tg 4:12; Christ, At 10:42, 2Tm 4:8, Tg 5:9; of those whose conduct is made a standard for judging, Mt 12:27, Lc 11:19; in the OT sense (Jz 2:16, Rt 1:1, al), of a ruler in Israel, At 13:20.†
SYN.: δικάστης, q.v (AS)

G2924.def:
κριτικός, -ή, -όν
(κρίνω),
critical, able to discern or judge: with genitive obj., Hb 4:12.†
(AS)

G2925.def:
Κρούω
[in LXX: before ἐπί Jz 19:22, Ct 5:2 (דָּפַק) ;]
with, accusative, τ. αὐλαίαν, Jdth.14:14 * ;]
to strike, knock: at a door (Κόπτειν, in Att..), Mt 7:7-8, Lc 11:9-10 12:36, At 12:16, Ap 3:20; with accusative, τ. θύραν, Lc 13:25, At 12:13.†
(AS)

G2926.def:
κρύπτη (WH, R; κρυπτή, LT, Tr.; -όν, Rec.), -ης, ἡ,
a crypt, cellar: Lc 11:33.†
(AS)

G2927.def:
κρυπτός, -ή, -όν
(κρύπτω) [in LXX for אָטַם, מִסְתָּר, etc. ;]
hidden, secret: Mt 10:26, Mc 4:22, Lc 8:17 12:2; ὁ κ. τῆς καρδίας ἄνθρωπος, 1Pe 3:4; neut., ἐν τῷ κ., Mt 6:4, 6; ἐν κ., Jo 7:4, 10 18:20; ὁ ἐν κ. Ἰουδαῖος, Rm 2:29; pl., τὰ κ. τ. σκότους, 1Co 4:5; τ. ἀνθρώπων, Rm 2:16; τ. καρδίας, 1Co 14:25; τ. αἰσχύνης, 2Co 4:2.†
κρυφαῖος, -αία, -αῖον
(κρύφα = κρυφῆ) [in LXX for מִסְתָּר, Jr 23:24, al. ;]
hidden, secret: ἐν τῷ κ., Mt 6:18.†
(AS)

G2928.def:
Κρύπτω
[in LXX for חָבָא, טָמַן, סָתַר, צָפַן, etc. ;]
to hide, conceal: with accusative, Mt 13:44 25:18; before ἐν, Mt 25:25 (pass., Mt 13:44, Cl 3:3); pass., Mt 5:14, Hb 11:23, 1Tm 5:25, Ap 2:17; ἐκρύβη (on the tense and its formation, see M, Pr., 161; Bl., § 19, 3) κ. ἐξῆλθεν Jo 8:59; before εἰς, Lc 13:21, Ap 6:15; ἀπό (in cl. more frequently dupl. accusative), Ap 6:16; pass., Jo 12:36, (Bl., § 34, 4). Metaphorical: Mt 11:25 13:35, Lc 11:52, WH, mg., Lc 18:34 19:42, Jo 19:38 (cf.ἀτο-, ἐν-, περι-κρύπτω).†
(AS)

G2929.def:
κρυσταλλίζω
(κρύσταλλος),
to shine like crystal, be crystal-clear: Ap 21:11 (ἅπ, λεγ.).†
(AS)

G2930.def:
κρύσταλλος, -ου, ὁ
(κρύος, frost), [in LXX: Jó 38:29, Sl 147:17, Eze.1:22 (קֶרַח), etc. ;]
crystal: Ap 4:6 22:1.†
(AS)

G2931.def:
κρυΦῇ
(prop. -ῆ, Rec.; later spelling is due to assimilation to dative; cf. εἰκῆ),
adv., [in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;]
secretly, in secret: Ef 5:12.†
(AS)

G2932.def:
κτάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX chiefly for קָנָה ;]
in pres., impf., fut. and aor., to procure for oneself, get, gain, acquire (the pf. and plpf., to have acquired, hence to possess, do not occur in NT): with accusative of thing(s), Mt 10:9, Lc 18:12, At 8:20; with genitive pret., At 22:28; ἐκ with genitive pret., At 1:18; τ,ψυχὰς ὑμῶν (MM, xvi), Lc 21:19; τ. ἑαυτοῦ σκεῦος κτᾶσθαι, 1Ts 4:4 (where if σ. = body, κ. must = pf., κέκτημαι; see MM, xvi; M, Th., in l; Field, Notes, 72 f. But σ. is most frequently taken as = wife; see Thayer, see word; Lft., Notes, 53 ff.; ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G2933.def:
κτῆμα, -τος, τό
(κτάομαι), [in LXX for כֶּרֶם, etc. ;]
a possession, property: Mt 19:22, Mc 10:22, At 2:45 5:1.†
(AS)

G2934.def:
κτῆνος, -ους, τό
(κτάομαι, hence primarily a possession), [in LXX chiefly for בְּהֵמָה Gn 1:25, al., also for מִקְנֶה, צֹנֵא, etc. ;]
a beast, (in late Gk. esp.) a beast of burden: Lc 10:34 pl. (as chiefly in cl.), At 23:24, Ap 18:13; of quadrupeds, as Opp. to fishes and birds (cf. Ge, l.with), 1Co 15:39.†
(AS)

G2936.def:
κτίζω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרָא, Sl 51:10, al.; also for קָנָה, Gn 14:19, Pv 8:22; יָצַר, Is 22:11 46:11; Wis.2:23, Sir.1:4, 9 (and freq.), I Et 4:53, a1. ;]
__1. in cl., to people or found a region or city (1Es, l.with).
__2. In LXX and NT, of God, to create: Mc 13:19, 1Co 11:9, Cl 1:16 3:10 Ef 3:9, 1Tm 4:3, Ap 4:11 10:6; ὁ κτίσας, Mt 19:4 (WH, R, mg.), Rm 1:25; of the divine operation on the soul, Ef 2:10, 15 4:24 (cf. Ps., l.with).†
(AS)

G2937.def:
κτίσις, -εως, ἡ
(κτίζω), [in LXX: Sl 104:24 (קִנְיָן), Pv 1:13 A (הוֹן), Tob.8:5, Wis.2:6, Sir.16:17, 3Ma.2:2, al. ;]
__1. a founding, settling, foundation (cl.).
__2. In LXX and NT,
__(a) the act of creating, creation: Mc 10:6 (Swete, in l), Mc 13:19, Rm 1:20, 2Pe 3:4;
__(b) that which has been created, creation: Rm 1:25 8:39, Hb 4:13; καινὴ κ., 2Co 5:17, Gl 6:15; πάσῃ ἀνθρωπίνῃ κ. (Hort., in l), 1Pe 2:13; collectively, of the sum of created things (Wis.19:6, Jdth.16:14), Mc 16:15, Cl 1:15, 23 Hb 9:11, Ap 3:14; of the irrational creation, Rm 8:19-22.†
(AS)

G2938.def:
κτίσμα, -τος, τό
(κτίζω), [in LXX: Wis.9:2 13:5 14:11, Sir.36:20 (17), Sir.38:34, 3Ma.5:11 * ;]
__1. (cl.) a colony.
__2. a created thing, creature: 1Tm 4:4, Tg 1:18, Ap 5:13 8:9.†
(AS)

G2939.def:
κτίστης, -oυ, ὁ
(κτίζω), [in LXX: 2Rs 22:32 (Heb., al.), Jdth.9:12, Sir.24:8, 2 24:1-34; 4Ma.5:1-38 * ;]
__1. (cl.) a founder.
__2. a creator: of God, 1Pe 4:19.†
(AS)

G2940.def:
κυβία (Mt. -εία, and so Rec.), -ας, ἡ
(κύβος, a cube, a die),
dice-playing; metaphorically, trickery, sleight: Ef 4:14.†
(AS)

G2941.def:
κυβέρνησις, -εως, ἡ
(κυβερνάω, Lat. gubernare, to guide), [in LXX: Pv 1:5 11:14 24:6 (תַּחְבֻּלָה) * ;]
__1. steering, pilotage (Plat.).
__2. Metaphorical, government: pl., 1Co 12:28.†
(AS)

G2942.def:
κυβερνήτης, -ου, ὁ
(see: κυβέρνησις), [in LXX for חֹבֵל, Eze.27:8, 27-28, Pv 23:24, 4Ma.7:1 * ;]
__1. a steersman, pilot: At 27:11, Ap 18:17.
__2. Metaphorical, a guide, governor (Eur., Plat.).†
(AS)

G2943.def:
κυκλόθεν
adv., (κύκλος), [in LXX chiefly for סָבִיב ;]
from all sides, round about: Ap 4:3-4, 8,†
(AS)

G2944.def:
κυκλόω, -ῶ
(κύκλος), [in LXX chiefly for סָבַב ;]
__1. to move in a circle, revolve.
__2. to surround, encircle: with accusative of person(s), Jo 10:24 (WH, txt., cf. -εύω), At 14:20; pass., Lc 21:20, Hb 11:30 (cf. περι-κυκλόω).†
(AS)

G2945.def:
κύκλος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for סָבִיב ;]
a ring, circle. Dat., κύκλῳ, as adverb., round about, around: Mc 3:34 6:6, 36, Lc 9:12, Rm 15:19; with genitive, Ap 4:6 5:11 7:11†
(AS)

G2946.def:
κύλισμα, -τος, τό
(κυλίω), [in Sm.: Eze.10:13 * ;]
__1. a roll.
__2. = κυλισμός (which see), a rolling, wallowing (or, as κυλίστρα, Xen., Eq., see 3, a rolling place): 2Pe 2:22 (Rec.).†
(AS)

G2947.def:
κυλίω late form of κυλίνδω,
[in LXX: Js 10:18, 1Rs 14:33, al. (גָּלַל), 4Ki.9:33 (שָׁמַט), al. ;]
to roll, roll along. Pass., to be rolled; of persons (in Hom, as sign of grief), to roll or wallow: Mc 9:20.†
(AS)

G2948.def:
κυλλός, -ή, -όν
__1. crooked, crippled: Mt 15:30-31 (WH, txt. om.);
__2. maimed: Mt 18:8, Mc 9:43.†
(AS)

G2949.def:
κῦμα, -τος, τό
(κύω, to be pregnant, to swell) [in LXX chiefly for גַּל ;]
a wave: pl., Mt 8:24 14:24, Mc 4:37; κ. θαλάσσης, figuratively, Ju 13.†
SYN.: κλύδων, q.v (AS)

G2950.def:
κύμβαλον, -ου, τό
(κύμβη, a cup), [in LXX chiefly for מְצִלָּה ;]
a cymbal: 1Co 13:1.†
(AS)

G2952.def:
κυνάριον, -ου, τό
(in Att.. also κυνίδιον, diminutive of κύων)
a little dog: Mt 15:26-27 Mc 7:27-28 †
(AS)

G2955.def:
κύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for קָדַד ;]
to bow the head, stoop down: Mc 1:7; before κάτω, Jo 8:6, 8 (cf. ἀνα-, παρα-, συν-κύπτω).†
κατα-κύπτω,
[in LXX: 4Ki.9:32 (שָׁקַף hi.)* ;]
to bend down, stoop: Jo 8:8 (κάτω κύψας, Rec., WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G2956.def:
Κυρηναῖος, -α, -ον
(Κυρήνη),
of Cyrene, a Cyrenæan: Mt 27:32, Mc 15:21, Lc 23:2, At 6:9 11:20 13:1.†
(AS)

G2957.def:
Κυρήνη, -ης, ἡ
Cyrene, a city in Libya: At 2:10.†
(AS)

G2958.def:
Κυρήνιος
(prop. -ίνιος, see Bl., 13; -ῖνος L, -εῖνος, Tr., WH, mg.), -ου, ὁ,
Quirinus, prop. Quirinius: Lc 2:2.†
(AS)

G2959.def:
κυρία
(Κυρία, T, WH, mg.), -ας, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for גְּבֶרֶת ;]
a lady: 2Jn.1 Jn 5 (on the interpretation, see ICC, 167 ff.).†
(AS)

G2960.def:
κυριακός, -ή, -όν
(κύριος), [in LXX: κ. φωνη (Συριακή φ., R), 2Ma.15:36 A * ;]
__1. as frequently in Inscr. (LS, see word; Deiss., BS, 217 f.), of the lord or master, imperial.
__2. of the Lord (i.e. Christ): δεῖπνον, 1Co 11:20; ἡμέρα, Ap 1:10. (cf. λόγια κ., Papias, Eus., HE, iii, 39, 1; γραφαὶ κ., Clem. Alex., etc; for eccl. usage, cf. Soph., Lex., see word)†
(AS)

G2961.def:
κυριεύω
(κύριος), [in LXX chiefly for מָשַׁל ;]
to be lord or master of, to rule (over): C. genitive obj., Lc 22:25, Rm 14:9, 2Co 1:24; absol., 1Tm 6:15; metaphorically, ὁ θάνατος, Rm 6:9; ἡ ἁμαρτία, Rm 6:14; ὁ νόμος, Rm 7:1 (cf. κατα-κυριεύω).†
(AS)

G2962G.def:
κύριος, -α, -ον (also -ος, -ον),
[in LXX (subst.) chiefly for יהוה, also for בַּעַל ,אָדוֹן, etc. ;]
having power (κῦρος) or authority; as subst., ὁ κ., lord, master;
__1. in general: with genitive of thing(s), Mt 9:38 20:8, Mc 12:9 13:35, Lc 19:33; τ. σαββάτου, Mt 12:8, Mc 2:28, Lc 6:5; with genitive of person(s), δούλου, etc., Mt 10:24, Lc 14:21, At 16:16, al.; absol, opposite to οἱ δοῦλοι, Ef 6:5, 9 al.; of the Emperor (Deiss., LAE, 161), At 25:26; θεοὶ πολλοὶ καὶ κ. πολλοί, 1Co 8:5; of a husband, 1Pe 3:6; in voc, as a title of respect to masters, teachers, magistrates, etc., Mt 13:27 16:22 27:63, Mc 7:28, Lc 5:12, Jo 4:11, At 9:5, al.
__2. As a divine title (frequently in π.; Deiss., LAE, 353 ff.); in NT,
__(a) of God: ὁ κ., Mt 5:33, Mc 5:19, Lc 1:6, At 7:33, Hb 8:2, Tg 4:15, al.; anarth. (Bl., §46, 6), Mt 21:9, Mc 13:20, Lc 1:17, Hb 7:21, 1Pe 1:25, al.; κ. τ. οὐρανοῦ καὶ τ. γῆς, Mt 11:25; τ. κυριευόντων, 1Tm 6:15; κ. ὁ θεός, Mt 4:7, 10 al.; id. before παντοκράτωρ, Ap 4:8; κ. σαβαώθ, Rm 9:29; (ὁ) ἄγγελος κυρίου, Mt 1:20 2:13, Lc 1:11, al.; πνεῦμα κυρίου, Lc 4:18, At 8:39;
__(b) of the Christ: Mt 21:3, Mc 11:3, Lc 1:43 20:44, al.; of Jesus after his resurrection (Dalman, Words, 330), At 10:36, Rm 14:8, 1Co 7:22, Ef 4:5, al.; ὁ κ. μου, Jo 20:28; ὁ κ. Ἰησοῦς, At 1:21, 1Co 11:23, al.; id. before Χριστός, Ef 1:2, al.; ὁ κ. ἡμῶν, 1Tm 1:14, Hb 7:14, al.; id. before Ἰησοῦς, 1Ts 3:11, Hb 13:20, al.; Χριστός, Rm 16:18; Ἰ Χ., 1Co 1:2, 1Ts 1:3, al.; Ἰ. Χ. (Χ. Ἰ) ὁ κ. (ἡμῶν), Rm 1:4, Cl 2:6, Ef 3:11, al.; ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ σωτὴρ, 2Pe 3:2; id. before Ἰ. Χ., ib. 18; anarth., 1Co 7:22, 25 Tg 5:4, al.; κ. κυρίων, Ap 19:16; with prep., ἀπὸ (κατὰ, πρὸς, σὺν, etc.) κ., Cl 3:24, al.
SYN: see: δεσπότης. (AS)

G2962H.def:
κύριος, -α, -ον (also -ος, -ον),
[in LXX (subst.) chiefly for יהוה, also for בַּעַל ,אָדוֹן, etc. ;]
having power (κῦρος) or authority; as subst., ὁ κ., lord, master;
__1. in general: with genitive of thing(s), Mt 9:38 20:8, Mc 12:9 13:35, Lc 19:33; τ. σαββάτου, Mt 12:8, Mc 2:28, Lc 6:5; with genitive of person(s), δούλου, etc., Mt 10:24, Lc 14:21, At 16:16, al.; absol, opposite to οἱ δοῦλοι, Ef 6:5, 9 al.; of the Emperor (Deiss., LAE, 161), At 25:26; θεοὶ πολλοὶ καὶ κ. πολλοί, 1Co 8:5; of a husband, 1Pe 3:6; in voc, as a title of respect to masters, teachers, magistrates, etc., Mt 13:27 16:22 27:63, Mc 7:28, Lc 5:12, Jo 4:11, At 9:5, al.
__2. As a divine title (frequently in π.; Deiss., LAE, 353 ff.); in NT,
__(a) of God: ὁ κ., Mt 5:33, Mc 5:19, Lc 1:6, At 7:33, Hb 8:2, Tg 4:15, al.; anarth. (Bl., §46, 6), Mt 21:9, Mc 13:20, Lc 1:17, Hb 7:21, 1Pe 1:25, al.; κ. τ. οὐρανοῦ καὶ τ. γῆς, Mt 11:25; τ. κυριευόντων, 1Tm 6:15; κ. ὁ θεός, Mt 4:7, 10 al.; id. before παντοκράτωρ, Ap 4:8; κ. σαβαώθ, Rm 9:29; (ὁ) ἄγγελος κυρίου, Mt 1:20 2:13, Lc 1:11, al.; πνεῦμα κυρίου, Lc 4:18, At 8:39;
__(b) of the Christ: Mt 21:3, Mc 11:3, Lc 1:43 20:44, al.; of Jesus after his resurrection (Dalman, Words, 330), At 10:36, Rm 14:8, 1Co 7:22, Ef 4:5, al.; ὁ κ. μου, Jo 20:28; ὁ κ. Ἰησοῦς, At 1:21, 1Co 11:23, al.; id. before Χριστός, Ef 1:2, al.; ὁ κ. ἡμῶν, 1Tm 1:14, Hb 7:14, al.; id. before Ἰησοῦς, 1Ts 3:11, Hb 13:20, al.; Χριστός, Rm 16:18; Ἰ Χ., 1Co 1:2, 1Ts 1:3, al.; Ἰ. Χ. (Χ. Ἰ) ὁ κ. (ἡμῶν), Rm 1:4, Cl 2:6, Ef 3:11, al.; ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ σωτὴρ, 2Pe 3:2; id. before Ἰ. Χ., ib. 18; anarth., 1Co 7:22, 25 Tg 5:4, al.; κ. κυρίων, Ap 19:16; with prep., ἀπὸ (κατὰ, πρὸς, σὺν, etc.) κ., Cl 3:24, al.
SYN: see: δεσπότης. (AS)

G2963.def:
κυριότης, -ητος, ἡ
(κύριος),
lordship, dominion: Ef 1:21, 2Pe 2:10, Ju 8; pl., Cl 1:16 (cf. Lft., Col; Mayor, Ju., in ll.; DB, i, 616 f.).†
(AS)

G2964.def:
κυρόω, -ῶ
(κῦρος, 1. authority. 2. validity), [in LXX for קוּם ;]
to confirm, ratify, make valid: 2Co 2:8; pass., Gl 3:15 (cf. προ-κυρόω).†
(AS)

G2965.def:
κύων, κυνός, ὁ, ἡ
(in NT masc. only), [in LXX forכֶּלֶב ;]
a dog: Lc 16:21, 2Pe 2:22; metaphorically, as a word of reproach, Mt 7:6, Fp 3:2, Ap 22:15.†
(AS)

G2966.def:
κῶλον, -ου, τό
a limb, member of a body,
[but in LXX (Lv 26:30, Nm 14:29, 32-33, 1Rs 17:46, Is 66:24*) for פֶּגֶר ;]
hence, carcase: Hb 3:17 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2967.def:
κωλύω
(κόλος), [in LXX for כָּלָא, מָנַע, etc. ;]
to hinder, re­strain, forbid, withhold: with accusative and inf., Mt 19:14, Lc 23:2, At 8:36 16:6 24:23, 1Ts 2:16, Hb 7:23; inf. om., Mc 9:38-39 10:14, Lc 9:49-50 11:52 18:16, At 11:17, Rm 1:13, 3Jn.10; accusative om., 1Tm 4:3; with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), At 27:43; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 14:39, 2Pe 2:16; id. before τοῦ μή, At 10:47; id. before ἀπό (like Heb. מִן כָּלָא, Gn 23:6, al.), Lc 6:29 (cf. δια-κωλύω).†
(AS)

G2968.def:
κώμη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for בַּת, חָצֵר, עִיר, etc. ;]
a village or country town, prop, as opposite to a walled city: Mt 14:15, Mc 6:6, al.; πόλεις καὶ κ., Mt 9:35, al.; with the name added, Βηθλεέμ, Jo 7:42; Βηθανΐα, Jo 11:1; with the name of the district, τὰς κ. Καισαρίας, Mc 8:27; Σαμαρειτῶν, Lc 9:52, At 8:25
(AS)

G2969.def:
κωμόπολις, -εως, ἡ
a country town: Mc 1:38 (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G2970.def:
κῶμος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Wis.14:23, 2Ma.6:4 * ;]
a revel, carousal: Rm 13:13, Gl 5:21, 1Pe 4:3.†
SYN.: see: κραιπάλη (AS)

G2972.def:
Κῶς genitive Κῶ, ἡ,
Cos, an island in the Ægean Sea: accusative Κῶ, At 21:1 (Κῶν, Rec.).†
(AS)

G2974.def:
κωφός, -ή, -όν
(κόπτω), [in LXX chiefly (Êx 4:11, al.) for אִלֵּם; for חָרָשׁ, Hc 2:18 ;]
blunt, dull. Metaphorical, of the senses, esp.
__(a) of speech, dumb: Mt 9:32-33 12:22 15:30-31, Lc 1:22 11:14;
__(b) of hearing, deaf: Mt 11:5, Mc 7:32, 37 9:25, Lc 7:22.†
(AS)

G2975.def:
λαγχάνω
[in LXX: 1Rs 14:47 (לָכַד, see Th., Gr., 38), Wis.8:19, 3Mac 61 * ;]
__1. to obtain by lot, to obtain (in cl., with genitive): with inf. art. (B1., § 36, 3; 71, 3), Lc 1:9; with accusative of thing(s), At 1:17, 2Pe 1:1.
__2. to draw lots: before περί, Jo 19:24
(AS)

G2976G.def:
Λάζαρος, -ου, ὁ
colloquial abbreviation of Ἐλεαζάρ (άζαρος), which see),
Lazarus;
__1. of Bethany: Jo 11:1 ff. Jo 12:1-2, 9-10 12:17.
__2. The beggar in the parable: Lc 16:20, 23-25.†
(AS)

G2976H.def:
Λάζαρος, -ου, ὁ
colloquial abbreviation of Ἐλεαζάρ (άζαρος), which see),
Lazarus;
__1. of Bethany: Jo 11:1 ff. Jo 12:1-2, 9-10 12:17.
__2. The beggar in the parable: Lc 16:20, 23-25.†
(AS)

G2977.def:
λάθρᾳ (Att..; in Hom., -ρῃ, Rec. -ρα),
adv., [in LXX chiefly for ‎סֵתֶר ;]
secretly: Mt 1:19 2:7, Mc 5:33 (WH, mg.), Jo 11:28, At 16:37.†
(AS)

G2978.def:
λαῖλαψ, -απος, ἡ
[in LXX: Jó 21:18 27:20 א (סוּפָה) Jó 38:1, Jr 25:32 (סַעַר), Wis.5:14, 23, Sir.48:9, 12 * ;]
a hurricane, whirlwind: Mc 4:37, Lc 8:23, 2Pe 2:17.†
SYN.: θύελλα, which see, and cf. ἄνεμος (AS)

G2980.def:
λαλέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for דּבר pi., also for אמר, etc. ;]
__1. to utter: of inanimate things, Ap 4:1 10:4; metaphorically, Hb 11:4 12:24.
__2. to talk, speak, say: absol., Mt 9:33 12:46, Mc 5:35, Lc 8:49; before ὡς, 1Co 13:11, Ap 13:11; εἰς, 1Co 14:9; ἐκ, Mt 12:34; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 10:19, Mc 11:32, Jo 8:30, al.; with dative of person(s), Mt 12:46, Lc 24:6, Rm 7:1, al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Mt 9:18, Jo 10:6, al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, Mc 6:50, Lc 1:19 2:33, al.; ἐν, ἐξ, ἀπό, Mt 13:3, Jo 12:49 14:10, al.; λ. τ. λόγον, Mc 8:32, al.; before orat. dir. (not cl.), Mc 14:31, Hb 5:5 11:18; Hebraistically (Dalman, Words, 25f.), ἐλάλησε λέγων, Mt 14:27, Jo 8:12, At 8:26, al.
SYN.: see: λέγω. (AS)

G2981.def:
λαλία, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר, דִּבְרָה ;]
__1. loquacity = Very talkative.
__2. talk, speech, conversation: Mt 26:73 (cf. Ca 43), Jo 4:42 8:43.†
(AS)

G2982.def:
λαμά (Heb. מָה, seel. λεμά = Aram. לְמָא)
why: Mt 27:46 (WH, mg., λεμά TTr., WH, txt., λεμά L), Mc 15:34 (λεμά LT, λαμμᾶ, Rec.).†
(AS)

G2983.def:
λαμβάνω,
[in LXX chiefly for לקח, also for אחז ,לכד ,נשׂא, etc. ;]
__1. to take, lay hold of: absol., Mt 26:26, Mc 14:22; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 5:40 26:52, al. mult.; with accusative of person(s), Mt 21:35, Mc 12:3, al.; pleonastic λαβών (M, Pr., 230; Bl., §74, 2), Mt 13:31 14:19, al.; so also indic., Mc 7:27, Jo 19:1, 40 Ap 8:5, al.; metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), ἀφορμήν, Rm 7:8, 11; ὑδόδειγμα, Tg 5:10; id. with accusative of person(s), φόβος, Lc 7:16; πνεῦμα, Lc 9:39; πειρασμός, 1Co 10:13; aoristic pf. (M, Pr., 145, 238; BL, §59, 4), Ap 5:7 8:5, al.
__2. to receive: absol., opposite to αἰτεῖν, Mt 7:8, al.; διδόναι, Mt 10:8, At 20:35; with accusative of thing(s), Mt 27:6, Mc 10:3o, al. mult.; with accusative of person(s), Jo 6:21 13:20 19:27, 2Jo.10; ῥαπίσμασιν (a vulgarism; Bl., §38, 3), Mc 14:65; metaphorically, τ. λόγον, Mt 13:20, Mc 4:16; τ. μαρτυρίαν, Jo 3:11; τ. ῥήματα, Jo 12:48; πρόσωπον (Heb. נָשָׂא פָּנִים, Dalman, Words, 30), Lc 20:21, Gl 2:6; ζωὴν αἰώνιον (Dalman, op. cit., 124f.), Mc 10:30 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀντι-, συν-αντι- (-μαι), ἀπο-, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, συν-παρα-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, συν-περι-, ὑπο-λαμβάνω).
(AS)

G2985.def:
λαμπάς, -άδος, ἡ
(λάμπω), [in LXX for לַפִּיד ;]
a torch (frequently fed, like a lamp, with oil): Mt 25:1 ff., Jo 18:3, At 20:8, Ap 4:5 8:10.†
(AS)

G2986.def:
λαμπρός, -ά, -όν
(λάμπω), [in LXX: Tob.13:11, Wis.6:12 17:20, Sir.29:22 33:13 (Sir.30:25) Sir.31:23, Ep. Je 60 * ;]
bright, brilliant: ποταμός, Ap 22:1 (ΕΥ, clear); ἀστήρ, Ap 22:16; of clothing, brilliant, splendid: Lc 23:11, At 10:30, Tg 2:2-3, Ap 15:6 18:14 19:8.†
(AS)

G2987.def:
λαμπρότης, -ητος, ἡ
[in LXX: Sl 110:3 (הָדָר), al. ;]
brightness, brilliancy: τ. ἡλίου, At 26:13.†
(AS)

G2988.def:
λαμπρῶς
adv.,
splendidly: of sumptuous fare (as freq.; cf. ἐδέσματα λαμπρά, Sir.29:22), Lc 16:19.†
(AS)

G2989.def:
λάμπω
[in LXX for נָגַהּ, etc. ;]
to shine: Mt 5:15-16 17:2, Lc 17:24, At 12:7, 2Co 4:6 (cf. ἐκ-, περι-λάμπω).†
(AS)

G2990.def:
λανθάνω
[in LXX for עָלַם ni., etc. ;]
to escape notice, be hidden (from): Mc 7:24, Lc 8:47; with accusative of person(s), At 26:26, 2Pe 3:5 3:8; as in common cl. idiom, before ptcp., ἔλαθον ξενίσαντες, entertained unawares, Hb 13:2 (cf. ἐκ-, ἐπι-λανθάνω).†
(AS)

G2991.def:
λαξευτός, -ή, όν
(λαξεύω; λᾶς, a stone, ξέω, to scrape), [in LXX: Dt 4:49 (פִּסְגָּה); in Aq.: Nm 21:20; Th.: Jz 7:11 * ;]
hewn (in stone); Lc 23:53 (elsewhere κοινή writers use λατομητός, 4Ki.12:12, al.; cf. λατομέω).†
(AS)

G2992.def:
λαός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX very frequently for עַם, Gn 14:16, al.; occasionally for לְאֹם ( Gn 25:23, al.), etc. ;]
a word rarely found in Att. prose;
__1. the people at large (Hom., al.), esp. of people assembled: Mt 27:25, Lc 1:21 3:15 al.; pl. (Hom., al., π.; see MM, xvi), At 4:27.
__2. a people, those of the same race and language (Pind., Æsch., al.: in LXX, Gn 26:11, Êx 9:16, al.): joined with γλῶσσα, φυλή, ἔθνος, Ap 5:9 7:9 11:9, al.; pl., Lc 2:31, Rm 15:11; esp. as almost always in LXX, of Israel, Mt 4:23, Mc 7:6, Lc 2:10, Jo 11:50, Hb 2:17, al.; opposite to τ. ἔθνη, At 26:17, 23 Rm 15:10; πρεσβύτεροι (πρῶτοι, etc.) τοῦ λ., Mt 21:23, Lc 19:17, At 4:8, al.; ὁ λ. μου (αὐτοῦ, τ. θεοῦ), Mt 2:6, Lc 1:68, Hb 11:25, al.; of the people disting. from the rulers and priests ( I Et 1:10, Jdth.8:9, al.), Mt 26:5, Lc 20:19, Hb 5:3, al.; of Christians, as the people of God, At 15:14, Rm 9:25, 26 Hb 4:9; περιούσιος, Tt 2:14; εἰς περιποίησιν, 1Pe 2:9 (LXX).
SYN.: see: δῆμος. (AS)

G2993.def:
Λαοδικία (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ
Laodicea, a city on the Lycus in Phrygia: Cl 2:1 4:13, 15-16, Ap 1:11 3:14.†
(AS)

G2995.def:
λάρυγξ, -γγος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for חֵךְ, Jó 6:30, al; Sl 5:9 (גָּרוֹן) ;]
the larynx, throat: metaphorically, of speech (cf. Sir.6:5), Rm 3:13" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G2996.def:
Λασέα (Rec. -αία), -ας, ἡ
Lasea, a city of Crete, otherwise un­known: At 27:8.†
(AS)

G2997.def:
λάσκω
__1. (in cl., poët.) to clang, crash, crack; in late prose, to crack or burst noisily: At 1:18 (ἐλάκησεν, perh., however, from λακέω, which see; Bl., in l).
__2. (in cl., prose) to scream, shout.†
λακέω, Dor. for ληκέω = λάσκω, q.v
(AS)

G2998.def:
λατομέω, -ῶ
(λατόμος, a stonecutter, 4Ki.12:12, al.; λᾶς, τέμνω; cf. λαξευτός) [in LXX: 1Cr 22:2, al. (חָצַב); Êx 21:33, Num_21:18 (כָּרָה) ;]
to hew, hew out stones: Mt 27:60, Mc 15:46.†
(AS)

G2999.def:
λατρεία, -ας, ἡ
(λατρεύω, which see), [in LXX (always of divine service): Êx 12:25-26 13:5, Js 22:27, 1Cr 28:13 (עֲבֹדָה), 1Ma.1:43 1Mac 2:19 1Mac 2:22, 3Ma.4:14 * ;]
__1. hired service, service.
__2. (in cl. also) divine service, worship: Jo 16:2, Rm 9:4 12:1, Hb 9:1, 6.†
(AS)
